features: Longest streak replaces Overall mood within the selected Insights period; duplicate and future days are excluded.
Weekly, monthly and yearly Plus subscriptions unlock all premium themes, AI tags and recaps.
Botanical, Coastal and Sunset are permanent non-consumable purchases; original Pastel remains free.
Theme preference survives subscription expiry; unavailable themes fall back to Pastel without changing journal drafts.
PCC managed entitlement remains in iOS Debug and all Release signing; Mac Debug uses a separate development entitlement file and falls back to the local model when it lacks PCC access.
Website privacy policy draft and in-app policy include transfinite@transfinite.us.
Previous Today tag layout restored; tag suggestions still generate automatically for Plus.
PCC is enabled by default, with a persisted off switch in Customize. Failed cloud requests retry once on device; cancellation does not retry.
Native SubscriptionStoreView and ProductView load real product identifiers directly, including when the catalog is initially empty.
Hosted privacy-policy URL is configured in StoreKit policy links and local App Store Connect app-info metadata.
Today and Pages save after a short typing pause, on navigation, and on app backgrounding; no Save control is required.
Autosave avoids empty pages and stale-query duplicates, preserves selected legacy entry identity, and clears deleted drafts.
Watch quick check-ins save automatically to their existing local store.
English, Spanish, and Arabic listing copy, app store copy, and real app screenshots are included.

verification.testCommand: xcodebuild test -project MoodMargins.xcodeproj -scheme MoodMargins -destination platform=macOS -only-testing:MoodMarginsTests CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
unitCoverage: Longest streak past runs, duplicates, future dates and range bounds
Every Plus duration grants the same access
Permanent themes do not unlock AI and remain accessible without Plus
Unavailable theme selection is rejected; preference survives reopening and access loss
No recap provider call without Plus; prior AI content clears
Free tagging preserves draft and selected tags
Existing journal persistence and synchronization regressions
PCC default/off persistence, cloud success/failure, local-only failure, cancellation, and failure of both models
Blank draft suppression and explicit mood-only check-ins
Autosave cancellation and recovery of a later typing draft
Flush before changing pages, stale queries, legacy entry IDs, and deletion without recreation
visualChecks: Reviewed all 57 public screenshot exports in localized preview sheets; no private journal or account information.
Checked complete theme labels, subtitle spacing, Mac frame edges, Arabic text shaping, emoji graphs, and native light/dark appearance.
All exported screenshots are opaque RGB PNGs at Apple-required dimensions.
Six product review screenshots show actual Customize or theme preview screens; no fabricated StoreKit catalog prices or purchase access.
verification.listingValidation: valid, no diagnostics, including all screenshot manifests
verification.bitrigBuildResult: Succeeded for configured Bitrig simulator and Mac targets. Mac development signing uses its dedicated Debug entitlement file; Release retains managed PCC.

covers: Autosave survives tab changes without a Save button
English, Spanish, and Arabic navigation and screenshots
Real theme previews and light/dark Insights
Empty drafts and explicit mood-only check-ins
One stable entry identity and reopening persistence
Cancellation retains the draft without writing

nativeMacCapture.method: ScreenCaptureKit current-process windows containing actual app feature views; live Metal-backed Lottie frames are rendered.

limitations: Listing, prices, availability, and screenshots are prepared locally and have not been applied to App Store Connect or submitted for review.
Apple must grant the managed PCC capability to the release App ID and provisioning profile. Actual PCC requests are not verified on an authorized device; the Mac Debug build uses the local fallback.

StoreKit catalog loads after applying product metadata, screenshot requirements, and propagation. On-device purchase/restore/expiry/refund checks remain pending. Refresh product review screenshots with loaded purchase controls before submission.
Main-app SwiftData uses the entitled private CloudKit container; actual two-device iCloud sync remains unverified. Watch journal data remains local.
The built-in iPhone accessibility inspection was unavailable; native CoreSimulator XCUIAutomation verified the iPhone and iPad workflows.
The hosted privacy policy still contains an obsolete on-device-only AI claim. Replace it with the reviewed Legal/PrivacyPolicy.txt draft and publish the App Privacy label before release.
